published_prior_art.cite: PennEtAl2025BudgetIV: nested-budget representation is the published starting point; exact-capacity assignment form is a routine useful reformulation.
PennEtAl2025BudgetIV gives the budget target; DufourTaamouti2005Projection supplies the projection geometry, while the separable graded-quota expression is a direct synthesis.
PennEtAl2025BudgetIV gives asymptotic confidence sets; the claimed simultaneous containment follows directly from one joint exact ellipsoid event in the expressly restricted Gaussian experiment.
Orlin1993MinCostFlow supplies the generic primitive; this is the natural exact-capacity encoding of the stated assignment problem.

SchlemperMoreira2026WeakIDCS exactly inverts fixed weak-IV statistics, but does not state a completeness theorem for a nested-quota lower envelope whose optimizer changes are certified by exchange cycles.
Fieller1954Ratio supplies one-ratio leading-coefficient geometry; no checked source supplies the quota-trimmed equality-case lexicographic certificate.
Dufour1997Impossibility is the general local-nonidentification mechanism; the proposal correctly presents this as supporting specialization.

ChernozhukovHongTamer2007 and Gafarov2025AffineSets provide adjacent set- and regular-geometry asymptotics; the labeled quota-envelope specialization is not checked as published but needs a precise regular-face domain.
LinPanPan2022EggerCoding establishes the applied coding-instability motivation, not an equivariance theorem for this budget procedure.
Fieller1954Ratio covers the p=1 reduction; WangKang2022WeakIVMR supplies the adjacent weak-IV robust AR comparison.
SchlemperMoreira2026WeakIDCS supplies ordinary-statistic root inversion but not an audited equality-complete parametric quota-envelope certificate.

soundness_flags.label: thm:regular-endpoint-limit
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem invokes separated positive-width regular faces, stable component pairing, unique active labels, and no exchange ties, but the stated assumptions only separate individual endpoint ratios and do not define or impose the needed component/assignment regularity.

soundness_flags.label: thm:complete-inversion and oeq:certified-backend
soundness_flags.one_line: The tail certificate and lambda_sigma are defined using q, whereas the claimed unconditional C_alpha^+ backend needs the equality-case tail decision recomputed at q^+; no q^+-parameterized certificate is defined.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:whole-set-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact coverage is conditional on fixed p and K, mutually independent exact Gaussian blocks, and known positive-definite covariance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform whole-set containment holds only in that exact Gaussian subexperiment, not for estimated covariance, residual LD, selection, or approximate GWAS normality.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:complete-inversion
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The exchange-cycle count is polynomial only with K fixed, and exact-q termination is relative to an exact-real sign oracle.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The unconditional terminating arithmetic claim is limited to the conservative rational-cutoff complex after the q^+-tail certificate is explicitly supplied.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings abstract, p. 2485 / PMLR page lines 14-16
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper gives tunable budget constraints, potentially disconnected sharp feasible sets under perfect observable covariance information, and confidence sets described as asymptotically valid.

The paper explicitly assumes independent two-sample reduced-form estimates with Gaussian summary-statistic laws, estimated covariance convergence, and weak-IV scaling; its Theorem 1 gives asymptotic null control for mrAR, mrK, and mrCLR.
The preprint develops exact and approximate inversion of ordinary weak-identification confidence regions, including root-based treatment of AR-type statistics and recovery of nonstandard components.

The cited version claims a finite-sample coverage guarantee for exactly calibrated uncertainty intervals when the user-specified violation set contains the true value; it does not, at this locator, state simultaneous containment of a population identified set.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add one primitive regular-face assumption requiring positive component widths and gaps, a unique active quota assignment/band at each finite endpoint, and a quantified exclusion of exchange ties; define component labels as part of that condition before retaining the endpoint-limit theorem.
Parameterize the tail polynomial and lexicographic certificate by an arbitrary cutoff q0, then instantiate it separately at q and q^+ so the rational backend certifies rays as well as finite roots.

State an explicit output-sensitive complexity bound for CertInv, including root-isolation bit complexity and the dependence on K, rather than only the structural-cell count; this would sharpen the field-level algorithmic contribution.
Obtain the exact published theorem/page locators for DufourTaamouti2005Projection and Gafarov2025AffineSets before making their theorem-number comparisons load-bearing.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two coherence defects, then rerun review with the q^+-specific tail construction and a formally stated regular-face/unique-label domain.
